test_title: SSC MTS 2025 Official Paper (Held On: 05 Feb, 2026 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Choose the most suitable one-word substitution for the following.

A government ruled by military.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 4**, i.e., **Junta**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word **"Junta"** refers to a government or ruling body formed by the military after taking control of a country, usually by force. (सैन्य शासन)
 
 
• **Example:** The junta declared martial law and took control of the nation's political framework.
 
 
• A junta is typically not elected and may impose strict measures to maintain control. (सामान्यतः निर्वाचित नहीं होता और नियंत्रण बनाए रखने के लिए कठोर उपाय लागू कर सकता है।)

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**, i.e., **Junta**.
